_comment: 🧩️ PDF 1.4/✳️a's own contribution to the repository test platform: the ISO 19005-1 (PDF/A-1) conformance vocabulary this subset owns, and the reference implementation that performs it independently. The ✳️any subset owns the document vocabulary and registers `lopdf` under `pdf-1-4-mutate`; this file registers the same package under a distinct id and the `pdf-1-4-a-mutate` capability the conformance case (`mutate-pdf-1-4-a`) tags, because reusing a neighbour's entry fails the contract with `oracle-capability-mismatch`.

oracles.rationale: `lopdf` both READS and WRITES the one axis check_pdf_a_conformance can honestly check on PDF 1.4's object-graph-less snapshot (page.text — whether the document has any extractable text at all), on a real document, which makes it a genuine second producer rather than a parser standing in for one — so every scenario is @mode-differential. Registered under its own id and capability so this subset's 4-kind conformance catalog is measured against a reference surveyed for that capability rather than borrowing the ✳️any subset's document-vocabulary entry.

comparisonProfiles.description: A PDF 1.4 document compared by the CONFORMANCE surface check_pdf_a_conformance actually reads, every field read back out of the bytes by the independent `lopdf` reader: page 1's extractable text, the emptiness verdict the checker computes from it, the page count as a stability anchor, and the unconditional schema-gap flag. Page CONTENT beyond that axis is deliberately absent — it belongs to the ✳️any subset's own profile, and this conformance check says nothing about it. `schemaGapUnverifiable` is the constant `true` the checker genuinely raises on every PDF 1.4 document; it is recorded as honest bookkeeping of an axis no mutation can move, never as evidence. No numeric field carries evidence, hence no tolerance.
